title: Feature-flag observability gates and dashboard lite spec
summary: A compact spec for lightweight observability gates and a minimal dashboard set to validate feature-flagged rollout slices (canary, 10%, 50%). Goal: low-cost, fast feedback that catches latency regressions, cold-cache regressions, and severe error spikes before broad rollout.
motivation: We need pragmatic, low-touch observability that can be enabled alongside feature flags without requiring the full telemetry stack or large dashboard real estate. Many engineers run small canaries and want clear go/no-go signals that are easy to interpret and actionable.
metric_definitions: 1) request_count: total API calls for the flagged route (tagged by feature_flag, route_id, model_version). 2) error_rate_critical: count(status>=500) / request_count over 5m and 1h windows. 3) p95_inference_lat_ms: 95th percentile of inference span duration (model runtime only), sliding 5m and 1h. 4) kv_cache_hit_ratio: kv_cache_hits / (kv_cache_hits + kv_cache_misses) for requests that used KV layer. 5) prefix_reuse_rate: fraction of requests that hit prefix cache. 6) cold_start_rate: fraction of sessions where model cold_start=true (session-level join). 7) token_cost_per_1k: estimated token compute cost normalized to 1k tokens per request (approximate). 8) quality_regressions: synthetic-eval-failures / eval_runs (see linked artifacts for eval set). Each metric must include these labels: feature_flag, rollout_slice (canary/10/50/all), model_version, region, tenant_id (where applicable). Aggregation windows: 1m, 5m, 1h, 24h.
trace_span_spec: Span names and key attributes to capture for the lightweight trace: 1) ingress.receive (attrs: request_id, route_id, feature_flag, tenant_id). 2) router.evaluate_policy (attrs: decision, fallback_reason, routing_latency_ms). 3) batcher.wait_window (attrs: batch_size, wait_ms). 4) kv_cache.lookup (attrs: kv_hit=true/false, key_count, lookup_ms). 5) model.infer (attrs: model_name, model_version, seq_len, tokens_generated, runtime_ms, gpu_id). 6) postprocess.serialize (attrs: token_truncation, output_size_bytes). 7) egress.send (attrs: status_code). Sampling strategy: always sample 1 in 100 requests for full spans, and sample 1 in 1 for any request where error_rate_critical triggers or p95_inference_lat_ms > threshold. Add a 'trace_anchor_id' for correlating eval synthetic runs with traces.
dashboard_notes: Design: 1) Tiny canary dashboard (one row per rollout_slice). Panels: - Topline: request_count, error_rate_critical (5m/1h), p95_inference_lat_ms (1h). - Cache health: kv_cache_hit_ratio, prefix_reuse_rate, cold_start_rate. - Cost & throughput: token_cost_per_1k, avg_tokens_per_req, throughput_rps. - Traces: quick link to sample traces for recent errors and high-latency requests. 2) Visual cues: green/yellow/red band for each metric per slice with thresholds (see gating_criteria). 3) Compact layout target: fits in a single 16:9 screen without scrolling for quick sprint checks. 4) Owner/last update widget: show rollout owner and last metric refresh time. 5) Query budget: keep panel queries capped to 2s and pre-aggregated rollups where possible.
gating_criteria: Hard gates (block progression): - error_rate_critical (1h) must be <= 0.5% for canary and <= 0.3% for 10%. - p95_inference_lat_ms (1h) must not increase by >25% vs baseline. - cold_start_rate (1h) must be <= baseline + 1 percentage point. Soft gates (require triage but can continue): - kv_cache_hit_ratio drop >10% vs baseline. - token_cost_per_1k increase >15%. Escalation: any hard gate failure triggers an automated rollback to previous feature_flag=false and creates JIRA ticket with prefilled investigation checklist.
migration_plan: Phase 1 (pilot, 2 weeks): enable instrumented metrics and traces for internal canary (team-only). Validate sampling, label coverage, and query performance. Phase 2 (wider canary, 1 week): enable dashboards and gates for 10% rollouts with synthetic eval runs every 30 minutes. Phase 3 (standardize): bake this lite spec into feature-flagging runbooks; provide flag config template that toggles telemetry. Rollback hooks: prebuilt terraform/feature-flag snippets and /ops/runbook that can disable flag and trigger warmup flow.
